description: RevenueDot is the open-source RevenueCat alternative: a self-hostable in-app purchase and subscription server that works with the RevenueCat SDK, plus paywalls, experiments and web checkout.
rules: RevenueDot implements the REST API the RevenueCat SDKs call, so an app that already uses the RevenueCat SDK switches by setting the SDK's proxy URL to https://api.revenuedot.app (RevenueDot Cloud) or to its own server.
Self-host with `docker compose up -d` using the image ghcr.io/revenuedot/revenuedot and a Postgres database; RevenueDot Cloud at https://app.revenuedot.app/signup is the hosted option.
Migrate from RevenueCat with `npx revenuedot import --from-revenuecat --rc-project <id> --to https://api.revenuedot.app`; the CLI is the npm package `revenuedot`.

The SDKs are MIT forks of RevenueCat's SDKs in separate repositories under github.com/revenuedot (purchases-ios, purchases-android, react-native-purchases, purchases-flutter, purchases-js and more); the server is AGPL-3.0.
The hosted MCP server is https://mcp.revenuedot.app/mcp, and the full docs live at https://revenuedot.app/docs with an llms.txt at https://revenuedot.app/llms.txt.
